name: Milli Featherwhistle
summary: Milli Featherwhistle is a master gnomish mechanostrider engineer stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. Following the fall of Gnomeregan, she meticulously handcrafts and maintains the clockwork mounts favored by her kin. She sells her prized mechanical creations to fellow gnomes and trusted allies of the exiled Gnomeregan survivors.

sections.title: Master of Mechanostriders
sections.body: Operating outdoors in the biting chill of Steelgrill's Depot just east of Kharanos, Milli Featherwhistle oversees the supply of clockwork steeds for Gnomeregan's displaced populace. Unlike the biological beasts favored by dwarves and night elves, Milli builds her entire inventory herself, personally calibrating gears, pistons, and balancing gyros to ensure each mechanical bird runs at peak efficiency across the snowy crags of Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Legacy of Mekkatorque
sections.body: Every frame and spring in Milli's workshop is rooted in blueprints originally drafted by High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. While Milli has integrated modern performance improvements over the years—streamlining chassis weights and refining exhaust vents—she faithfully adheres to the High Tinker's foundational schematics. Her mechanical wonders prove that even in exile, gnomish technological ambition remains thoroughly unbroken.

faq.answer: Milli Featherwhistle is the primary mechanostrider breeder and engineer for the gnomes of Gnomeregan. Stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, she hand-builds and sells clockwork mechanostriders to eligible riders.

faq.q: Where can I find Milli Featherwhistle?
faq.answer: She is located at Steelgrill's Depot, an engineering outpost situated just a short walk east down the road from the town of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Who is allowed to purchase mounts from her?
faq.answer: By default, only gnomish adventurers have the immediate clearance and aptitude to purchase her creations. Members of other Alliance races must earn the utmost trust and exalted status with the Gnomeregan Exiles before she will entrust them with a mechanostrider.

Milli Featherwhistle crafts each mechanostrider herself, basing her construction on the iconic blueprints drafted by High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque while implementing custom engine and balance enhancements.

faq.q: What mount varieties does she offer?
faq.answer: She provides several calibrated models, ranging from standard unpainted, blue, green, and red frames to finely tuned swift variants finished in white, green, and yellow coatings.

faq.q: Why is she working out in the snow at Steelgrill's Depot?
aliases: why is milli in dun morogh
faq.answer: After the radioactive catastrophe and trogg invasion drove the gnomes from Gnomeregan, refugees gathered wherever they could. Steelgrill's Depot serves as a natural staging hub outside Kharanos for vehicular testing and mechanical maintenance alongside dwarven engineers.

angles.text: Milli Featherwhistle is your people's premier mount engineer, carrying forward High Tinker Mekkatorque's technological genius even while exiled from your subterranean home.
Milli's mechanostriders represent the pinnacle of large-scale gnomish locomotion, combining gyroscopic balance units with high-torque mechanical limbs.
Alliance heroes who earn the utmost respect of the Gnomeregan Exiles can seek out Milli to command one of the swiftest mechanical mounts on Azeroth.
